capabilities: Sync notes from Obsidian to Ghost CMS
Schedule, publish, or backdate posts via YAML frontmatter
View scheduled and published posts in an editorial calendar sidebar
Mark the paywall boundary with a --members-only-- marker
Convert Markdown to Ghost's Lexical format on a save-triggered or periodic schedule
extras: Installation is manual via GitHub Releases (no community plugin store listing mentioned); two-way sync, pages, and media upload are listed as future features. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to Ghost CMS or manage Ghost post metadata, scheduling, and paywalls from the vault.

relations.evidence: JWT authentication - Secure Ghost Admin API integration

summary: One-way sync plugin that publishes Obsidian notes to Ghost CMS with post scheduling, YAML metadata control, and an editorial calendar.
